def isPalindromeHelper (x : List Char) (i j : Nat) : Bool :=
  if i < j then
    match x[i]?, x[j]? with
    | some ci, some cj =>
      if ci ≠ cj then false else isPalindromeHelper x (i + 1) (j - 1)
    | _, _ => false  -- This case should not occur due to valid indices
  else true
